rounds.text: Bluspring Enterprises is currently undergoing a powerful fundamental transformation, evidenced by a massive 152% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E15]. This performance is not merely a statistical anomaly, as the company is successfully converting its operational success into tangible liquidity, generating Rs 52 Cr in operating cash flow and Rs 24 Cr in free cash flow as of March 2026 [E24, E25]. The efficiency of this profit generation is highlighted by an operating cash flow that reached 167% of operating profit [E26]. Furthermore, the company is maintaining a disciplined balance sheet with a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.20x and a successful reduction in total borrowings [E27, E29]. Market participants are beginning to recognize this momentum, as evidenced by a 100 relative-strength rating against the Nifty 500 and a 71.5% twelve-month price return [E38, E39]. Conceded: the company faces significant valuation headwinds with a P/E of 145x and a P/B of 3.28x, alongside a negative return on equity [E1, E2, E13, E58].
